items.label: Multi-Purpose Application
items.value: This blanket ladder can be used in the living room, bedroom, bathroom or any other tight corners for hanging towels, blankets, washcloth, scarves or ornaments, adding an unique vibe for you home

items.label: Space Saver
items.value: This wall leaning shelf is sized in 17.3"L x 63"W with occupying little floor space. 5 shelves are ample for hanging your blankets or bath towels while 4 removable hooks help with your coats, scarves and hats

items.label: Solid Structure
items.value: The stylish vintage particle board with the high-quality metal frame endows the towel rack with good stability and load-bearing capacity.The blanket rack is also equipped with an anti-tip kit and plastic tube sleeves to increase its stability and effectively prevent the towel holder from scratching the floor

items.label: Stylish and Noble
items.value: Without complicated patterns and gorgeous decorations, our towel rack design adopts simple lines and clean colors. This can be well integrated into a variety of decoration styles. In addition, it also provides freedom for your room decoration!

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: With easy-to-understand installation instructions, numbered accessories and mounting tools in the package, you can assemble the ladder shelf quickly and easily

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Included Components
items.value: Towel Rack, Accessory Kit, Instructions, Hooks

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Includes easy-to-understand installation instructions, numbered accessories, and mounting tools. Follow the step-by-step guide to assemble the ladder shelf quickly and easily.
